title: DaysCounter
description: Day Counter  is a clean and lightweight Fabric mod that adds a simple day counter to your Minecraft HUD
body:
Day Counter

Day Counter** is a clean and lightweight Fabric mod that adds a simple day counter to your Minecraft HUD.

Instead of opening the F3 debug screen just to check the current day, this mod displays the day directly on your screen in a clean format like:

**Day: 01**

This is useful for survival players, hardcore worlds, Minecraft 100 Days challenges, multiplayer SMPs, content creators, and anyone who wants an easy way to track world progress.

## Features

* Shows the current Minecraft day on your HUD
* Clean display format: **Day: 01**
* Works in singleplayer and multiplayer when installed on the client
* Perfect for Hardcore, Survival, SMP, and 100 Days challenges
* Press **K** to cycle the HUD position
* Supports multiple screen positions:

  * Top Left
  * Top Center
  * Top Right
  * Center Left
  * Center
  * Center Right
  * Bottom Left
  * Bottom Center
  * Bottom Right
* Optional HUD toggle key through Minecraft Controls
* Config file support for changing text, color, margin, shadow, background, and position
* Lightweight and simple, with no unnecessary extra features

## Config

After launching the game once, the config file will be created here:

`.minecraft/config/sg-day-counter.json`

You can edit options like:

* Enable or disable the HUD
* Change the position
* Change the prefix text
* Change minimum digits
* Change text color
* Enable or disable shadow
* Enable or disable background
* Adjust margins

## Controls

Default key:

**K** — Cycle HUD position

The toggle key is available in Minecraft keybind settings but is unbound by default. You can set it from:

**Options → Controls → Key Binds → SG Day Counter**

## Recommended For

* Minecraft Survival
* Hardcore Minecraft
* 100 Days Challenges
* SMP gameplay
* YouTube recordings
* Live streams
* Players who want a clean day counter without using F3
